product_summary: Website (sarjak.com, home + About us + Equipment pages) shows a pure project-logistics / shipping operator, not a goods producer or trader: (1) Odd Dimensional Containerised Cargo (ODC/OOG) on own special equipment; (2) Breakbulk, Heavylift, vessel owning & chartering (vessel 'SCL Mercury'); (3) Heavylift on container vessels; (4) End-to-end project logistics - road transport, customs clearance, stuffing/operations. Equipment fleet page lists only container types they own/operate: 20'/40' Open Top, High Cube Open Top, Hard Top Open Top, Flat Rack (31/47 MT payload), Super Rack, Flat Rack with collapsible ends - i.e. equipment for their own transport operations, no sale offer, no catalogue, no prices, no product specs for goods. Industries served: oil & gas, automotive, infrastructure, glass, power/energy, steel, military & UN cargo, mining - these are cargo types carried for clients, not products sold. No fuel/lubricant (2710), no filter/purifier elements (8421) anywhere on the site.
role_hint: trader (service provider / freight forwarder & NVOCC-type logistics operator; not a manufacturer, not a goods trader)
comment: HS mismatch, company kept per Rule 3 - verdict accepted_hs_corrected. Declared 271019 (petroleum oils), 842139/842199 (filter/purifier parts) have NO corroboration on the company's own website: no such product line, catalogue or offer exists - status 'заявлено, не подтверждено'. 732690 (iron/steel articles) is at best a partial fit only if they trade container spares/fittings, which the site does not show; their steel equipment (flat racks, open tops) is own-use fleet, not a sale item. Industry claimed 'Нефтегаз и химия' is a misclassification: oil & gas is only a client vertical for project cargo, the company itself is in shipping/project logistics (transport & warehousing services, indicative HS 9801 / chartering 8901). Trader/service signs: no factory, no product specs, no price list, only service pages, tracking, IGM/B-L tools, detention tariff and local charges - classic logistics operator. Product lines missing from the declaration: containerised ODC/OOG transport, breakbulk & heavylift, vessel chartering, end-to-end multimodal project logistics. Note: no customs line was available to me in this task, so no shipment-level corroboration of any code; all product statements above rest solely on sarjak.com pages (home, /about-us/, /equipment/). Sub-pages for services returned 404 on guessed URLs and the search tool was unavailable, so service-level detail beyond the homepage menu was not verified.
